description_full: TAL Education Group provides smart learning solutions in the People's Republic of China. It offers learning services through Xueersi Peiyou small classes, personalized premium services, and online course offerings. The company also develops and provides learning content solutions for learners across print, digital and device-based formats, including print books, books integrated with digital learning experiences, learning devices, and mobile applications. In addition, it offers online education services, including live class and pre-recorded course content through www.xueersi.com. Further, the company engages in development and sale of software, network, and learning devices; investment management and consulting services. TAL Education Group was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.

financial_summary: TAL Education Group is a mid-cap consumer defensive business with a $5.7B market cap on $3.0B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +43% over the past three years and +17% annually across the full decade, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at -7% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 53% confirm genuine pricing power.

The business throws off $508M in free cash flow — roughly 17 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.13× so those profits are backed by real cash.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin -78.1× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 11.3% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.
